The bug causing a `NullPointerException` when calculating the data range for an axis with a `null` renderer in [`XYPlot`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/chart_4_group_d_fix/source/org/jfree/chart/plot/XYPlot.java#L4492-L4502) has been fixed.

### Root Cause
In [`XYPlot.getDataRange(ValueAxis axis)`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/chart_4_group_d_fix/source/org/jfree/chart/plot/XYPlot.java#L4425), when iterating over datasets mapped to an axis, `getRendererForDataset(d)` can return `null` if no renderer is assigned to the dataset. While the bounds calculation conditionally handled `r == null`, the subsequent lines unconditionally called `r.getAnnotations()`, throwing a `NullPointerException`.

### Solution
Added a null check `if (r != null)` prior to accessing `r.getAnnotations()` in [`XYPlot.java`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/chart_4_group_d_fix/source/org/jfree/chart/plot/XYPlot.java#L4492-L4501).

### Verification
The Cucumber test suite passes completely with 0 failures and 0 errors:

